steps.rule: If no explicit config path and cached policy is present and disabled, return None (allow).
Extract host via urlparse hostname else netloc, normalize strip/lower/rstrip-dot, with schemeless '//' fallback.
If extracted host is empty, return None (allow).
Load policy from config path (default HERMES_HOME/config.yaml) with 30s TTL cache; missing config or PyYAML yields disabled default; build deduplicated normalized rules.
On WebsitePolicyError, log warning and allow for default path, re-raise for explicit config_path; any other exception logs and allows.
If loaded policy enabled is false, return None (allow).
For each rule pattern, block when host matches via equality, '.pattern' suffix, or fnmatch for '*.', returning block dict.
